o: Meridianos son los infinitos semicírculos máximos que pasan por los polos de la Tierra. Dos meridianos opuestos forman un círculo máximo que divide a la Tierra en dos hemisferios.

Tomando como referencia el meridiano de origen o de Greenwich, se divide la Tierra en dos hemisferios: Hemisferio oriental: situado al ESTE del meridiano origen y Hemisferio occidental: situado al OESTE del meridiano origen.

en.q: Try as I _______ , I couldn't turn the key.
en.r: Concesiva con inversión: «Try as I might, …» = por mucho que lo intentara. Estructura fija verbo + as + sujeto + might/may.

en.q: _______ you to change your mind about handing in your notice, we would be happy for you to stay with us.
en.r: Condicional con inversión: «Were you to change…» = If you were to change… (si llegaras a cambiar de opinión).

en.q: I find _______ very strange that Meena has not been promoted yet.
en.r: «find it + adjetivo + that/to…»: «it» anticipa la oración que viene después (I find it strange that…).

en.q: Did you really understand all _______ he said?
en.r: Tras «all» se usa «that» (no «what»): «all that he said» = todo lo que dijo.

en.q: Please come and see me _______ day you like.
en.r: «any» = cualquier (el que quieras): «any day you like».

en.q: His grandfather often dozes _______ in front of the TV after dinner.
en.r: «doze off» = quedarse dormido, dar una cabezada.

en.q: Only on very rare occasions _______ an appearance before midday.
en.r: «Only on (very rare) occasions…» al inicio → inversión: «would the old lady make».

en.q: He escaped by _______
en.r: Expresión fija «by a hair's breadth» = por los pelos.

en.q: _______ he should have spent all the weekend preparing for his test, he in fact just lay in bed watching videos.
en.r: «Whereas» = mientras que (contraste entre lo que debía hacer y lo que hizo).

en.q: _______ with being so busy both at work and at home, she became increasingly tired and bad-tempered.
en.r: «What with + sustantivo/-ing» = entre una cosa y otra, debido a (varias causas).

en.q: I benefited a great deal _______ taking that online training course.
en.r: «benefit from + -ing» = beneficiarse de algo.

en.q: In such a plight _______ that we had no choice but to radio for help.
en.r: «In such a plight / So… that» al inicio → inversión: «did we find ourselves».

en.q: Why do you object to _______ - he'll be an asset to the company?
en.r: «object to + objeto + -ing»; en pasiva: «object to him being taken on» (que lo contraten).

en.q: Unfortunately, their house _______ while they were at the restaurant celebrating their anniversary.
en.r: Pasiva con «get» para algo que nos pasa (desgracias): «their house got burgled».

en.q: If the decision _______ before he arrived, he would have been furious.
en.r: Condicional tipo 3: if + past perfect (pasivo): «If the decision had been taken…, he would have been…».

en.q: You must phone us as soon as you _______ home.
en.r: Tras «as soon as / when / before / until» con sentido futuro se usa PRESENTE (no will): «as soon as you get home».

en.q: I can reassure you that everything _______ as quickly as possible.
en.r: Pasiva de «deal with»: la preposición se mantiene: «will be dealt with».

en.q: Bob couldn't ______ a moustache to the photo of his Headmaster in the newspaper.
en.r: «can't resist + -ing» = no poder resistirse a hacer algo.

en.q: This time next week I won't be in a stuffy office, _______ on a beach in Spain.
en.r: Futuro continuo «will be + -ing» = algo que estará en curso en un momento futuro (this time next week).

en.q: He crept in _______ his parents should wake up.
en.r: «lest + sujeto + should» = por miedo a que, para que no.

en.q: Capital punishment was done _______ in Britain nearly half a century ago.
en.r: «do away with» = abolir, eliminar.

en.q: No offence intended _______ I think you haven't understood the problem correctly.
en.r: Fórmula «No offence (intended), but…» = sin ánimo de ofender, pero…

en.q: I take great exception _______ the implication that I was not telling the truth.
en.r: «take exception to» = ofenderse por, objetar.

en.q: In such a complex situation as this mistakes _______ happen occasionally.
en.r: «be bound to + inf» = ser seguro que ocurra: «mistakes are bound to happen».

en.q: No one wants to have extra homework tonight, _______?
en.r: Sujeto «no one» → tag en plural con «they» y afirmativo (la frase ya es negativa): «…, do they?».

en.q: _______ your house repainted every year?
en.r: Causativa habitual con «have» como verbo principal: «Do you have your house repainted every year?».

en.q: I had no difficulty _______  their house although they had said that people often did.
en.r: «have (no) difficulty + -ing» = (no) tener dificultad en hacer algo.

en.q: I'm sure he only said those things _______.
en.r: Finalidad: «to + inf» (para molestarme): «to annoy me».

en.q: James is staying with   _______ while he is in New York   their son, Nick Green, will then come back with James for a few weeks over here.
en.r: Familia entera: «the + apellido en plural»: «the Greens» = los Green.

en.q: The more I get to know him, the _______ I like him.
en.r: Comparativos correlativos: «the more…, the less…» = cuanto más…, menos…

en.q: Women had to fight hard to gain _______ equality.
en.r: Sustantivos abstractos en sentido general van SIN artículo: «gain equality».

en.q: I've never heard _______ ridiculous speech.
en.r: «such a + (adj) + sustantivo singular»: «such a ridiculous speech».

en.q: All their children are allowed _______ exactly what they like.
en.r: «be allowed + to + inf».

en.q: The old lady came near to _______ of pneumonia but to everyone's amazement she pulled through.
en.r: «come near to + -ing» = estar a punto de (to es preposición).

en.q: I had no sooner told her what I thought of her _______ I wished I'd held my tongue.
en.r: «No sooner… than…» (con «than», no «when»).

en.q: I _______ rather you didn't tell my parents about this.
en.r: «I would rather + sujeto + pasado» = preferiría que no le dijeras.

en.q: We promised to keep in touch _______ happened to us in life.
en.r: «whatever happened» = pasara lo que pasara.

en.q: We were at a disadvantage _______ that we did not have a very good knowledge of the language the others were using.
en.r: «in that» = en el sentido de que, ya que.

en.q: The President resigned; the whiff of scandal remained _______
en.r: «nevertheless» = aun así, sin embargo (dimitió; aun así el olor a escándalo permaneció).

en.q: If you can win his attention _______ for you.
en.r: Expresión fija «so much the better» = tanto mejor.

en.q: My daughter is planning to spend a year before university working in Australia, _______ seems to me to be a sensible idea.
en.r: «which» tras coma referido a toda la oración anterior (lo cual me parece sensato).

en.q: I can't imagine any reason _______ he should have behaved in such an extraordinary way.
en.r: «any reason why…» = ninguna razón por la que…

en.q: I borrowed a _______ bike and went into town in the lunch break.
en.r: Doble genitivo con el 's al final del grupo: «a friend of mine's bike» (la bici de un amigo mío).

en.q: They live about _______ from here.
en.r: Genitivo de tiempo/distancia: «an hour's drive» = a una hora en coche.

en.q: It was the collapse of the dotcom boom that finally did _______ him.
en.r: «do for sb» (informal) = arruinar, acabar con alguien.

en.q: By the time you're my age, you _______ your mind.
en.r: «By the time + presente» → futuro perfecto: «you will (probably) have changed your mind».

en.q: When I first came to Britain it took me a long time to _______ on the left.
en.r: «get used to + -ing» = acostumbrarse a (to es preposición).

en.q: You'd rather stay at home tonight, _______you?
en.r: «You'd rather…» = You WOULD rather → tag con «wouldn't you?».

en.q: Kevin'll do well in the job _______ he stays on the right side of the boss.
en.r: «as long as» = siempre que, con tal de que.

en.q: Thank you very much  I haven't been to _______ party for ages.
en.r: «such a/an + adjetivo + sustantivo»: «such an enjoyable party» (an delante de vocal).

en.q: We'd all been at school together for 12 years and at our leaving celebrations we  _______ eternal friendship.
en.r: «pledge eternal friendship» = jurar amistad eterna.

en.q: I felt an _______ with the writer from his descriptions of a world that seemed to have a great deal in common with my own.
en.r: «feel an affinity with» = sentir afinidad con.

en.q: One of the most powerful pressure groups in the country is the road and car _______, which opposes any legislation that will increase taxes specifically for them.
en.r: «lobby» = grupo de presión.

en.q: Take care that your love for him doesn't _______ your judgement.
en.r: «cloud one's judgement» = nublar el juicio.

en.q: Do you have any figures showing the _______ of left-handedness is in the general population?
en.r: «incidence» = frecuencia/índice de algo en una población (estadística).

en.q: In her speech the Prime Minister _______ tribute to the valuable contributions to society made by voluntary organisations.
en.r: «pay tribute to» = rendir homenaje a.

en.q: The weather is going to change soon  I can feel it in my _______ .

en.q: There is a very strong movement now against _______ sports like hunting or shooting.
en.r: «blood sports» = deportes de sangre (caza).

en.q: Maria and Jean had a _______ romance  they met and married within two months.
en.r: «a whirlwind romance» = un romance relámpago.

en.q: The boys ran out of the old man's garden when he _______ his fist and shook his stick at them.
en.r: «clench one's fist» = apretar el puño.

en.q: In the course of his long life in business George G. Matthews _______ a substantial fortune.

en.q: Ever year many small companies get _______ up by large multinationals.
en.r: «be swallowed up by» = ser absorbido por (empresas).

en.q: Why not buy the dress on ______  then you can take it back if it doesn't fit your mother.

en.q: I'm looking forward to meeting your new boss  you've been _______ his praises ever since he arrived.

en.q: Although the twins look identical, they have widely _______ opinions on almost every topic under the sun.

en.q: Anyone who lies under oath will be charged with _______ the course of justice.

en.q: James never really broke the rules but he did _______ them a little bit when it suited him.

en.q: The recently discovered documents _______ credence to Professor Vaughan's interpretation of events.

en.q: The princess's nanny's autobiography really gives the _______ on life among the royals.

en.q: It's as if that silly argument we had has driven a _______ between us and we've lost all our old closeness.

en.q: The nuclear industry _______  most of the country's electrical power.

en.q: Most critics praise that actor's work but I think he's rather _______.

en.q: The country has few natural resources and its economy has been _______ for some time now.

en.q: It was so hot in the restaurant that, after half an hour, we were all starting to _______ .

en.q: My sister likes wearing tight tops and close-fitting dresses but I prefer _______;  sweaters and jeans.
en.r: «baggy» = holgado, ancho (ropa).

en.q: Serena is still  _______  ignorant of the fact that she is about to be made redundant.

en.q: The book _______ to a number of interesting research studies which I would really like to find out more about.
en.r: «allude to» = aludir a, hacer referencia a.

en.q: _______  to popular belief, Pluto is not a planet.
en.r: «Contrary to popular belief» = al contrario de lo que se cree.

en.q: I'm afraid that argument really doesn't hold _______
en.r: «hold water» = sostenerse, ser válido (un argumento).

en.q: The children's interest in playing the game soon _______
en.r: «flag» = decaer, flaquear (interés, energía).

en.q: I don't think Paul will ever get married  he's the stereotypical _______ bachelor.

en.q: I'm sure I was invited to join the committee as the _______ woman.

en.q: Unfortunately, his report doesn't _______ with what we've learnt from other sources.
en.r: «tally with» = cuadrar, coincidir con.

en.q: A great deal can be _______ about the composer's state of mind from his works at this period.
en.r: «deduce about» = deducir. [Nota: «inferred» también sería posible en este contexto; la clave oficial da «deduced».]

en.q: What do you _______ as the main issues affecting the situation?
en.r: «perceive X as» = percibir/considerar X como.

en.q: All sides have to accept that the arbitrator's decision will be _______

en.q: Sometimes a pension can provide you with a _______ sum on retirement as well as or instead of a monthly income.
en.r: «lump sum» = cantidad única, pago global.

en.q: It was a close _______ but we just made it to the airport on time for our flight.
en.r: «a close call» = por los pelos, casi no.

en.q: I'd like to _______ my argument with an anecdote whose significance will soon become apparent.
en.r: «preface X with» = introducir/precedir algo con.

en.q: The UN has called for an immediate _______ of hostilities.

en.q: Not many people are good at assessing their own abilities and Mark must be _______ for recognising that he would never become a great musician.

en.q: The _______ of things was that he was sacked from a job that he had held for over twenty years.

en.q: It's always nice to see Bella  she's such a _______ of sunshine.
