en.q: Tamara has set her _______ on becoming a ballet-dancer.
en.r: «set one's heart on» = desear algo con todas sus fuerzas.

en.q: After the football match the crowds _______ out of the stadium into  the nearest bars and cafes.
en.r: «pour out of» = salir en masa (multitud).

en.q: Marlene is quite _______ - I don't know she manages to fit everything in.
en.r: «indefatigable» = incansable.

en.q: I wish those pesky neighbours _____ having wild, loud parties every single night of the week!
en.r: «I wish + sb + would + infinitivo» expresa queja o deseo de que OTRA persona cambie una conducta molesta (presente/futuro). Con «I wish + pasado simple» (stopped) hablas de una situación presente irreal, no de un hábito que molesta.

en.q: It's stuffy in here. Shall I open the window? - _____ .
en.r: Para aceptar un ofrecimiento con «Shall I…?» se responde con el imperativo enfático «Do» (= sí, hazlo). «You shall» suena a orden solemne y no responde a la oferta.

en.q: My arm hurt like hell so I tried _____ some painkillers, but they didn't do any good.
en.r: «try + -ing» = probar algo como experimento para ver si funciona (tomé analgésicos a ver si iban bien). «try + to + inf» = intentar/esforzarse en hacer algo difícil.

en.q: As the family drove into the village they were amazed to see _____ endlessly.
en.r: Verbos de percepción (see, hear, watch) + objeto + -ing = ver una acción EN PROCESO (desfilando). Con infinitivo sin «to» (see them parade) se ve la acción completa. El objeto va SIEMPRE antes del verbo.

en.q: When they told me to remember to return the next day I said _____ .
en.r: Estilo indirecto: «will» pasa a «would» al reportar en pasado. «I will» → «I said I would».

en.q: Obviously, I would buy those antique chairs if I could _____ .
en.r: Elipsis: tras «afford» se mantiene el «to» para evitar repetir el verbo: «if I could afford to (buy them)». «afford it» haría falta un objeto en singular; aquí son «chairs».

en.q: The riot squad sprang into action and the protesters _____ run back to the alleys.
en.r: «make sb do» en activa, pero en PASIVA reaparece el «to»: «they were made TO run». Verbos causativos/percepción en pasiva: be made to do, be seen to do, be heard to do.

en.q: Before we set off next week I'd like to _____ . I'll call the garage in the morning.
en.r: Causativa «get/have + objeto + participio» = encargar a otro que haga algo (el taller revisará el coche): «get the car serviced».

en.q: Hopefully I _____ by the time Mary gets out of bed.
en.r: «by the time + presente» marca un límite futuro → futuro perfecto (will have + participio): la acción estará terminada antes de ese momento.

en.q: These products, despite what _____ by some consumers, are not harmful.
en.r: «what» como sujeto («lo que») concuerda en SINGULAR: «what is believed». Además es pasiva (lo que creen algunos consumidores).

en.q: - Shall we book a table for two at the new restaurant? - Ok, _____ .
en.r: Para aceptar una sugerencia (Shall we…?) se contesta «OK, let's» (elipsis de «let's book it»).

en.q: So I was going to meet my Waterloo, _____ ? Well, who's met his Waterloo now, eh?
en.r: Question tag de eco/sarcasmo: se repite el auxiliar en la MISMA forma (afirmativa) y el sujeto del enunciado: «I was going to…, was I?».

en.q: This bedroom wants _____ . I'll buy a brush first thing in the morning.
en.r: «want/need + -ing» tiene sentido pasivo (= necesita ser pintado): «This bedroom wants painting» = needs to be painted.

en.q: You can't open the can? Try _____ my opener!
en.r: «try + -ing» = probar un método/solución (prueba a usar mi abrelatas). Ver también 17A-3.

en.q: Albert looks as if he _____ in the garden all day. He's all worn out!
en.r: «look as if + presente perfecto continuo» cuando la apariencia es real y actual (está agotado porque ha estado trabajando todo el día). El pasado (had been) se usa cuando lo comparado es irreal.

en.q: They _____ their property before the great housing boom. With hindsight, a terrible mistake.
en.r: Pasado perfecto (had sold) para una acción anterior a otro momento pasado (antes del boom). «With hindsight» (visto en retrospectiva) confirma que es pasado.

en.q: If you _____ your way, simply ask a local, as they are always willing to help foreigners.
en.r: «If you should + infinitivo» = si por casualidad…; condicional de posibilidad remota con imperativo en la otra parte («simply ask»).

en.q: I wish I _____ work shifts.
en.r: «I wish + pasado simple» = deseo sobre una situación PRESENTE (ojalá no tuviera que trabajar a turnos). «wouldn't have to» no se usa con el sujeto I en wish.

en.q: _____ take a seat, I'll be with you in a minute.
en.r: «If you will + infinitivo» es una fórmula cortés de petición (= tenga la amabilidad de…). «will» aquí significa voluntad, no futuro.

en.q: All I did was _____ the front door, as usual.
en.r: «All I did was + infinitivo sin to» (o con to): en las cleft sentences con «do», lo que va tras «was» es el infinitivo: All I did was lock the door.

en.q: _____ to help, there was nothing left to do but wind up the firm.
en.r: Cláusula absoluta: cuando el sujeto de la cláusula de participio es distinto al de la principal, se expresa delante: «The bank having refused to help, …».

en.q: There are four suspects, _____ have an alibi.
en.r: Relativo tras coma para personas con cuantificador: «none / some / all + of WHOM». «which» es para cosas; «who» no va tras preposición.

en.q: _____ you want and _____ you need are often quite different things.
en.r: «What» = «lo que» (relativo nominal) en ambas partes: What you want and what you need…

en.q: The woman _____ in the driver's seat was obviously very nervous.
en.r: Participio presente activo (sitting) = «que estaba sentada». «being seated» sería pasivo/proceso de sentarla.

en.q: It is vital _____ admitted to hospital at once.
en.r: Subjuntivo tras «It is vital / essential / important that»: sujeto + verbo en forma base para todas las personas: «that he BE admitted».

en.q: All countries deserve to have a voice, _____ their weight in world affairs.
en.r: «regardless of» = sin tener en cuenta, independientemente de. «with regard to / regarding» = en lo que respecta a (no encaja).

en.q: _____ Jenny had to sell her house after all.
en.r: Cleft sentence: «What happened was that + oración» = lo que pasó fue que… Es la estructura fija para introducir un suceso.

en.q: _____ a fire extinguisher in a garage, but I can't see one anywhere.
en.r: Existencia → «There is / there's supposed to be» (se supone que hay). «It is supposed to be» se refiere a algo ya mencionado.

en.q: _____ I called you _____ I have a business proposition in mind.
o: The motive for which / was that
en.r: «The reason why… was because/that…» = la razón por la que te llamé es que… (estructura fija «the reason why»).

en.q: The idea is _____ with you as far as the next town.
en.r: «The idea is for + objeto + to + infinitivo» = la idea es que nosotros vayamos. «for us to go».

en.q: _____ the fire should reach the village, all the people were promptly evacuated.
en.r: «Lest + sujeto + should + inf» = por miedo a que / para evitar que (formal).

en.q: Do you object _____ to further my career?
en.r: «object to + -ing»: «to» es preposición, así que va seguido de -ing; el sujeto del gerundio se expresa con posesivo o pronombre objeto: «object to my attempting».

en.q: Roger _____ arrived yesterday, but he still hasn't shown up.
en.r: «was/were to have + participio» = un plan que estaba previsto y NO se cumplió (tenía que haber llegado ayer, pero no ha venido).

en.q: Make sure you sleep on a firm mattress at night. _____ lying flat on your back; instead try a curled position on your side
en.r: «avoid + -ing» = evitar hacer algo. «prevent» necesita objeto (prevent sb from doing); «abstain from»; «restrain» = contener.

en.q: Some flight attendants live outside their home base and commute to work. _____ may choose to work only on regional flights.
en.r: «Others» = pronombre plural (otros [auxiliares]). «Other» es solo adjetivo (necesita sustantivo detrás).

en.q: Check-in staff may need to _____ baggage and stand for long periods.
en.r: «lift» = levantar (peso). «rise» es intransitivo (subir algo por sí solo); «raise» sí es transitivo pero no se ofrece.

en.q: _____ rare, some airports may not have parking facilities.
en.r: «Although + adjetivo» (elipsis de «although it is rare»). «Despite» va con sustantivo/-ing, no con un adjetivo solo.

en.q: We loved sitting in the fantastic, _____ seats in the lobby of the hotel.
en.r: Orden de adjetivos: OPINIÓN/cualidad (soft) → COLOR (grey) → MATERIAL (leather) → sustantivo. Regla OSASCOMP: opinion, size, age, shape, colour, origin, material, purpose.

en.q: Although it is not well kept, this museum houses a _____ collection of Egyptian art.
en.r: «priceless» = de valor incalculable (¡positivo!). «worthless / valueless» = sin valor; «penniless» = sin dinero.

en.q: _____ you decide, I’ll support you.
en.r: «Whatever you decide» = decidas lo que decidas (cualquier cosa). «Whichever» se usa cuando hay un conjunto limitado de opciones.

en.q: Following his reckless statement to the press, the leader of the group has been asked to _____ .
en.r: Phrasal verb «step down» = dimitir, dejar un cargo. «step up» = intensificar; «set out» = partir/exponer.

en.q: _____ service can be an alternative to prison for some minor crimes.
en.r: «community service» = trabajos en beneficio de la comunidad (pena alternativa). Colocación fija.

en.q: My old aunt is really _____ . She never seems to remember anything these days!
en.r: Adjetivo «forgetful» = olvidadizo (persona). «forgettable» = que se olvida fácilmente (cosa).

en.q: Pilots may spend a considerable amount of time away from home because of overnight _____ .
en.r: «layover» = escala/parada con pernocta en un viaje (especialmente tripulaciones). Vocabulario de aviación.

en.q: On international flights, senior attendants frequently _____ the work of other attendants.
en.r: «oversee» = supervisar (verbo, presente tras sujeto plural). «overseas» = en el extranjero; «overseen» = participio; «overlook» = pasar por alto / dar a (vistas).

en.q: The prices on the menu aren’t _____ I expected.
en.r: Comparativo de igualdad modificado: «nearly as + adjetivo + as» (no tan caros como esperaba). «nearly» va delante del primer «as».

en.q: In 2008 the world financial system came close to a complete _____ .
en.r: «meltdown» = colapso total (financiero o nuclear). Colocación: «a complete meltdown».

en.q: He didn’t mean to say that. She got mad but it was just a big _____ .
en.r: «misunderstanding» = malentendido. «mishap» = percance; «setback» = contratiempo.

en.q: Helen always loved reading as a child so _____ she ended up owning a bookshop!
en.r: Adverbio que comenta toda la frase: «unsurprisingly» = como era de esperar (le encantaba leer → acabó con una librería).

en.q: Good fashion designers translate brilliant ideas into _____ clothes.
en.r: Adjetivo «wearable» = que se puede llevar (ropa ponible). «worn out» = gastado; «weary» = cansado.

en.q: Sorry, I can't make it tomorrow. I _____ my psychotherapist.
en.r: Presente continuo para citas/planes ya acordados en el futuro: «I'm seeing my psychotherapist tomorrow».

en.q: - Listen! That'll be Rita jangling keys! - That _____ Rita. She's not due till 12:30.
en.r: Deducción negativa en presente con certeza: «can't be» (no puede ser). «mustn't» expresa prohibición, NO deducción.

en.q: _____ your fiancée was coming along with you I'd have prepared some fancy food.
en.r: Condicional tipo 3 con inversión (formal): «Had I known…» = If I had known… El «if» desaparece y el auxiliar pasa delante.

en.q: Excuse me, could you please tell me _____ to Paddington Station?
en.r: Pregunta indirecta: tras «could you tell me» el orden es de afirmación (sujeto + verbo): «how I can get». Y «get to» un lugar.

en.q: The boys ran out of the old man's garden when he _____ his fist and shook his stick at them.
en.r: «clench one's fist» = apretar el puño (colocación fija). «grit one's teeth» = apretar los dientes.

en.q: Do remember _____ your laptops by next Thursday.
en.r: «remember + to + inf» = acordarse de hacer algo en el futuro (no olvides traer). «remember + -ing» = recordar algo que ya pasó.

en.q: We set off at ten, and we _____ a cup of tea at noon.
en.r: «stop + -ing» = dejar de hacer (dejaron de conducir); luego «had a cup of tea» en pasado simple. «stop to + inf» = parar PARA hacer otra cosa.

en.q: I'd rather cousin Ashley _____ next Christmas. She's a real pain in the neck.
en.r: «I'd rather + sujeto + pasado simple» = preferiría que otra persona… (presente/futuro): «I'd rather she didn't come».

en.q: During our conversation I kept looking away, because his breath and all his body _____ of garlic.
en.r: «smell» es un verbo de estado: no se usa en continuo cuando significa «oler a». Pasado simple: smelled of garlic.

en.q: Speaking of myths, not all Brits are as cold and distant as they _____ .
en.r: Elipsis: «as they are supposed TO (be)». Se conserva el «to» para no repetir el verbo.

en.q: I recommend that your brother _____ to find a new job. He's stuck in a rut here.
en.r: Subjuntivo tras verbos de sugerencia/recomendación (recommend, suggest, insist, demand) + that: verbo en forma base sin -s: «that your brother TRY».

en.q: I'm finding it hard _____ on the right.
en.r: «find it hard + to + inf». Y «get used to + -ing» (to es preposición): «to get used to driving».

en.q: After a brief, light-hearted introduction the lecturer _____ the reasons for the fall of the Roman Empire.
en.r: «go on + to + inf» = pasar a hacer algo distinto a continuación (tras la introducción, pasó a hablar de…). «go on + -ing» = seguir haciendo lo mismo. El adverbio «promptly» va delante del verbo.

en.q: I never remember locking the door when I'm leaving and then turn around and check it. And I always feel a proper fool when I see _____ .
en.r: Elipsis con el auxiliar del tiempo correcto: «remember locking» → al ver que SÍ lo he cerrado: «when I see I have (locked it)». Se repite el auxiliar del presente perfecto.

en.q: I _____ those suitcases if only you'd ask.
o: might have helped you to carry
would have helped you to carry
en.r: Condicional tipo 2: «I would help… if only you'd (= you would) ask». «help sb carry» sin «to» es lo más natural.

en.q: - May I smoke in here? - To tell you the truth, I'd rather _____ . Nobody else is a smoker here.
en.r: «I'd rather + sujeto + pasado simple» = preferiría que tú no lo hicieras (presente): «I'd rather you didn't».

en.q: As Sam walked into the cathedral he heard a shot _____ once. Only once. Then silence.
en.r: «hear + objeto + infinitivo sin to» = oír la acción completa (un solo disparo): «heard a shot ring out». Con -ing sería una acción en curso/repetida.

en.q: According to that sign, it is forbidden to park on _____ . We'll have to look for another place to leave the car.
en.r: «either side» = cualquiera de los dos lados = ambos lados (singular). «both sides» llevaría plural pero el sentido de la señal es «en ninguno de los dos lados se puede aparcar» → «either side». «neither» haría doble negación con «forbidden».

en.q: _____ I realized he was seriously ill.
o: It wasn't till I saw him that
Not till did I see him
It was when I saw him
en.r: «It wasn't until… that…» = no fue hasta que… cuando… (cleft enfático). Estructura fija: It wasn't till/until X that Y.

en.q: Just look at this _____ sweater. I think I'll buy it.
en.r: Orden de adjetivos: opinión (lovely) → tamaño (extra-large) → color (yellow).

en.q: "People said he had caused the break-up." He _____ the break-up.
en.r: Pasiva impersonal: «He was said to have caused» (se decía [pasado] que había causado [anterior]). Infinitivo perfecto «to have + participio» para una acción anterior.

en.q: _____ has the release of a motion picture created such a rumpus.
en.r: Adverbio negativo al principio → inversión: «Hardly ever has…». «Hardly never» es doble negación (incorrecto).

en.q: Smugglers _____ operate in the area, but evidence is hard to come by.
en.r: Pasiva personal: «Smugglers are known to operate» = se sabe que los contrabandistas operan.

en.q: We had missed our chance. It was _____ to be able to solve the problem.
en.r: «far too + adjetivo» (intensificador delante de too) + «for + persona + to + inf»: far too late for us to be able…

en.q: Someone found the dead body, _____ ?
en.r: Question tag con «someone/somebody/everyone/no one» usa «they»: «Someone found…, didn't they?».

en.q: It's unlikely _____ up at all. They must have forgotten about the party.
en.r: «It's unlikely that + futuro»: es improbable que aparezcan. «for them to turn» necesitaría «turn up» y no encaja con «at all» aquí; la opción correcta mantiene «turn up».

en.q: I would hate _____ I'm taking advantage of you.
en.r: «would hate + objeto + to + inf» = odiaría que pensaras: «I would hate you to think». Igual que would like/love/prefer sb to do.

en.q: We can reduce our production costs by 15%, _____ undercutting our competitors.
en.r: «thus + -ing» = de este modo / con lo que (consecuencia): «thus undercutting our competitors».

en.q: The Head Teacher said we are all _____ a written exam tomorrow.
en.r: «be to + inf» = plan/instrucción oficial. En pasiva: «we are all to be given an exam» (nos van a poner un examen).

en.q: Of the two siblings, Marjorie is _____ actor.
en.r: Con DOS elementos se usa el comparativo con «the»: «Of the two, she is (much) the better actor». El superlativo es para tres o más.

en.q: _____ time I had in Benidorm!
en.r: Exclamación con sustantivo contable singular: «How + adj + a + sustantivo!» o «What a + adj + sustantivo!». Aquí: «How wonderful a time…!».

en.q: The working day in factories is commonly divided into day and night _____ .
en.r: «shifts» = turnos de trabajo (day/night shifts).

en.q: It was a _____ guy, about six feet tall, carrying a six- _____ blade knife.
en.r: Adjetivos compuestos: el sustantivo va en SINGULAR y con guion: «six-inch blade» (no inches). Con rasgos físicos se añade -ed: «blue-eyed».

en.q: I'm looking forward to meeting your new boss — you've been _____ his praises ever since he arrived.
en.r: Expresión fija «sing someone's praises» = deshacerse en elogios hacia alguien.

en.q: Flight attendants must be _____ to passengers’ needs.
en.r: Adjetivo «attentive to» = atento a (las necesidades). «attention» es sustantivo.

en.q: The patient is _____ a series of tests to determine the actual problem.
en.r: «undergo tests / surgery / treatment» = someterse a pruebas, operación, tratamiento.

en.q: I will be with you in _____ .
en.r: «a quarter of an hour» = un cuarto de hora (expresión fija con «an hour»).

en.q: Contrary to popular _____ drugs aren't a great source of inspiration to the artist.
en.r: Expresión fija «contrary to popular belief» = al contrario de lo que se cree. Tras adjetivo va el sustantivo «belief».

en.q: “I’m sorry. You are not on the list. You must have _____ your last name”.
en.r: «misspell» = escribir mal (ortografía) un nombre o palabra. «mistake» = confundir.

en.q: Even if that happens, _____ you mustn’t do is panic!
en.r: Cleft sentence: «What you mustn't do is panic» = lo que no debes hacer es entrar en pánico. «what» = «lo que».

en.q: Developed countries need to cut down on fuel _____ by having fewer cars on the road.
en.r: Sustantivo «consumption» = consumo (fuel consumption). «consumerism» = consumismo.

en.q: _____ too often nowadays people put their careers before their private lives.
en.r: Expresión fija «all too often» = con demasiada frecuencia.

en.q: The book wasn’t very good. In fact it was rather _____ .
en.r: -ing = causa el sentimiento (el libro decepciona → disappointing). -ed = cómo se siente la persona (I was disappointed).

en.q: Guiding lights direct aircraft on its _____ approach.
en.r: «landing approach» = aproximación para el aterrizaje: sustantivo usado como adjetivo (landing) delante de approach.

en.q: Flight attendants should have tact and _____ to handle difficult situations.
en.r: Tras «have tact and…» hace falta un SUSTANTIVO paralelo a «tact»: «resourcefulness» (ingenio, recursos). «resourceful» es el adjetivo.

en.q: _____ learn emergency procedures, including evacuating aircraft and operating emergency equipment.
en.r: «trainee» = persona en formación (alumno). «trainer» = el que forma.

en.q: She’s just bought a _____ farmhouse.
en.r: Orden de adjetivos: opinión (beautiful) → edad (eighteenth-century) → origen (French) → material (stone) → sustantivo.

en.q: The factory needs to increase its _____ in order to cope with the demand.
en.r: «output» = producción (cantidad que produce una fábrica). «outcome» = resultado; «turnout» = asistencia/participación.

en.q: The story was a bit _____ but I still enjoyed it!
en.r: «unearthly» = sobrenatural, extraño. Hace falta un ADJETIVO tras «a bit»; «unrealistically» es adverbio. «unparalleled» = sin igual (no encaja con «but I still enjoyed it»).

en.q: Runners are advised to drink plenty of water because _____ can be a serious problem.
en.r: «dehydration» = deshidratación. Prefijo de- para invertir/quitar.

en.q: Well, kids, isn't it high time you _____ to bed?
en.r: «It's (high/about) time + sujeto + PASADO simple» = ya es hora de que… (presente, con matiz de retraso): «you went to bed».

en.q: Your hair needs _____ . Go to the hairdressers right away.
en.r: «need + -ing» = necesitar ser hecho (sentido pasivo): «needs cutting» = needs to be cut.

en.q: Ten o'clock! It's time _____ .
en.r: «It's time + sujeto + pasado» (ver 17C-1): «It's time we left». También vale «It's time for us to leave», pero no «for us leaving».

en.q: If I hadn't been wearing my seatbelt I _____ in the crash.
en.r: Condicional tipo 3: if + past perfect → would have + participio. «get killed» es la pasiva con get: «would've got killed».

en.q: While _____ in the West Indies he fell in love with a most remarkable woman.
en.r: Cláusula reducida con conjunción + -ing cuando el sujeto es el mismo: «While living in…» (= while he was living).

en.q: I wish I _____ money for a rainy day when I was top of the charts!
en.r: «I wish + past perfect» = lamentarse de algo del PASADO (ojalá hubiera ahorrado cuando…).

en.q: Imagine _____ a million pounds – how would you have spent all that money?
en.r: «imagine + -ing»; con «having + participio» porque se imagina un hecho ya completado (haber ganado) y la pregunta va en condicional 3 (would you have spent).

en.q: No matter how I tried, I couldn't help _____ she was going to betray me.
en.r: «can't/couldn't help + -ing» = no poder evitar hacer algo.

en.q: Even if Boris _____ to two-time his boss, would he have got away with it?
en.r: Condicional tipo 3 (would he have got away): la condición va en past perfect: «Even if he had been able to».

en.q: Wilkins, I regret _____ that, from this very moment, you do not work here anymore. In other words, you're fired.
en.r: «regret + to + inf» = lamentar tener que decir/comunicar algo AHORA (fórmula para dar malas noticias). «regret + -ing» = arrepentirse de algo pasado.

en.q: If I get it right, I am the one that's got to buy the chocolates, _____ ?
en.r: Question tag irregular: «I am…, aren't I?» (no «amn't I»).

en.q: Most of the times I end up bored to tears, but I _____ to my lectures with plenty of time to spare in case of last minute problems.
en.r: «like + to + inf» = hacer algo por costumbre porque se considera conveniente (me gusta llegar con tiempo de sobra), aunque no se disfrute.

en.q: I'd still be a single man now if _____ in the high street on that unforgettable afternoon.
en.r: Condicional mixto/3: «if I hadn't been window-shopping» (acción en curso en el pasado) → consecuencia en presente «I'd still be single now».

en.q: - Did Alison let her son go to the fairground? - No, he wasn't _____ . He's too young to walk home alone at night.
en.r: En pasiva «let» no se usa: se dice «be allowed to». Por elipsis se mantiene el «to»: «he wasn't allowed to (go)».

en.q: The old lady wanted to know when _____ .
en.r: Pregunta indirecta: orden sujeto + verbo, sin auxiliar do/does: «when the fair begins».

en.q: Everything's been just perfect. We've been listening to beautiful music, the soup _____ delicious and the dessert has been quite a surprise!
en.r: La clave da «tasted» (pasado simple) porque la sopa es un momento concluido de la comida. [Duda razonable: «has tasted» también se oye, pero en exámenes con «taste» = verbo de estado se prefiere el simple y el continuo «has been tasting» es incorrecto.]

en.q: I _____ look inside this box, thank you very much.
en.r: «dare» como modal: «dare not + infinitivo sin to» (daren't look). Como verbo normal: «don't dare (to) look».

en.q: _____ , we were able to sail in our dinghy around the bay.
en.r: Cláusula absoluta con sujeto propio distinto al de la principal: «The weather having improved, we…».

en.q: _____ , all the students interviewed were satisfied with the timetable.
en.r: Adverbio comentario al inicio de la frase: «Interestingly, …» = curiosamente.
Expresión fija «for goodness' sake» (apóstrofo tras la s, sin s extra).

en.q: _____ news of your family?
en.r: «news» es INCONTABLE y va en singular: «Is there any news…?».

en.q: Having a bathroom _____ is infinitely better than sharing it.
en.r: «of one's own» = propio (a bathroom of one's own = un baño propio).

en.q: _____ off workers, the management hopes to reduce losses.
en.r: «By + -ing» = mediante, haciendo algo (método): «By laying off workers…». «lay off» = despedir.

en.q: _____ Ethan's help, we would still be stranded on the road.
en.r: «If not for / If it weren't for / But for + sustantivo» = de no ser por. «If not for Ethan's help».

en.q: _____ you ran out of petrol, what would you do?
en.r: «Supposing + pasado» = suponiendo que… (condición hipotética), equivale a «what if».

en.q: You can do what you like. It is _____ my business.
en.r: «It is none of my business» = no es asunto mío (expresión fija).

en.q: Jack _____ . We are just acquainted.
o: is not a friend of me
en.r: «be no friend of mine» = no es amigo mío (doble genitivo: a friend of mine).

en.q: _____ the turning point as the gamblers started to raise the stakes.
en.r: Inversión tras adverbio de lugar/tiempo al inicio con verbos de movimiento: «Then came the turning point» (sin do auxiliar).

en.q: _____ magic. I refuse to believe in hocus pocus.
o: There is no such thing as
en.r: «There is no such thing as + sustantivo» = no existe tal cosa como…

en.q: On behalf of all your colleagues: _____ to enjoy your retirement!
en.r: Fórmula de deseo con «may» invertido: «Long may you live!» (¡que vivas muchos años!).

en.q: A state-of-the-art project is looking at _____ emotional detection into GPS car navigation devices.
en.r: «build something into something» = incorporar/integrar algo en un sistema (build emotional detection into GPS devices).

en.q: I can manage on my own, thank you. - Oh, come on! _____ help you.
en.r: Imperativo enfático «Do let me help you» = déjame ayudarte, por favor (insistencia). «Do» refuerza el imperativo.

en.q: It was just _____ for tennis, so we stayed indoors.
en.r: Orden con «too»: too + adjetivo + a/an + sustantivo: «too windy a day». (Igual que «so/as/how + adj + a + noun»).

en.q: Controllers must work rapidly and efficiently _____ maintaining total concentration.
en.r: «while + -ing» = mientras (al mismo tiempo que) se mantiene la concentración. Conjunción de simultaneidad.

en.q: Airlines make every effort in order to ensure a _____ travel experience.
en.r: Adjetivo «pleasant» delante de un sustantivo (a pleasant experience). «pleasure» es sustantivo.

en.q: The cup will be kept on _____ at the clubhouse for a month. Later it will be sent to the museum.
en.r: «on display» = expuesto/en exhibición (expresión fija). «on show» existe, pero sin artículo; la clave da «display».

en.q: It was that the _____ faulty and had to be replaced.
en.r: «equipment» es INCONTABLE: sin plural y con verbo en singular: «the equipment was faulty».

en.q: Our teacher gave us _____ problem to solve.
en.r: Los adjetivos extremos/absolutos (impossible, fantastic, exhausted) se gradúan con «absolutely», no con «very / fairly». Y «an» delante de vocal.

en.q: Due to _____ emissions of greenhouse gases, this ice sheet is melting at an alarming rate.
en.r: «rising» = en aumento (adjetivo). «rise» es intransitivo; «raised» = elevado por alguien (pasivo).

en.q: Supermarkets try to persuade customers to return _____ bottles.
en.r: Sufijo -able = que se puede: «reusable bottles» = botellas reutilizables.

en.q: If you would like to take part in the race, all you have to do is pay an _____ fee.
en.r: «entry fee» = cuota de inscripción/participación (colocación). «entrance fee» = precio de entrada a un lugar.

en.q: After working for so long, they brought some snacks, _____ was really kind of them.
en.r: Relativo «which» tras coma para referirse a TODA la oración anterior (lo cual fue muy amable). «that» no va tras coma.

en.q: _____ you don’t get the job this time, I’m sure there will be more opportunities in the future.
en.r: «Even if» = aunque (concesión hipotética): aunque no consigas el trabajo esta vez…

en.q: Their objective is to keep traffic levels _____ for the airport.
en.r: «manageable» = manejable, controlable (adjetivo con -able).

en.q: Airline pilots may be _____ firearms to protect the cockpit.
en.r: «be issued (with) something» = recibir algo oficialmente (armas, documentos, uniformes).

en.q: Dealing with emergencies and _____ customers can be difficult.
en.r: «unruly» = revoltoso, indisciplinado (pasajeros problemáticos).

en.q: The flat was located in a _____ but central part of town.
en.r: «rundown» = deteriorado, en mal estado (barrio). «runaway» = fugitivo/desbocado.

en.q: The government has introduced _____ .
en.r: «a tax on + sustantivo» y genitivo con plural irregular: «children's clothes» (children → children's).

en.q: Arsenal won the match, but _____ players played well, in fact they _____ played quite badly.
en.r: «none of the players» = ninguno de los jugadores (más de dos). «neither» es solo para dos. Luego «they all played…».

en.q: Peter lost his driving license on account of _____ driving.
en.r: Adjetivo «careless driving» = conducción temeraria/imprudente. «uncautious» no se usa.

en.q: _____ great importance, work-family balance is usually not in the political agenda.
en.r: «Albeit + adjetivo/frase» = aunque, si bien (formal): «Albeit of great importance» = aunque sea de gran importancia. «Despite / In spite of» irían con sustantivo sin «of great…».

en.q: The economic crisis affected _____ of new investments in developing countries.
en.r: Tras el verbo «affect» hace falta un sustantivo: «the making of new investments». El gerundio con artículo funciona como sustantivo.

en.q: If you cannot help _____ , remember that worrying cannot help you.
en.r: «can't help + -ing» = no poder evitar hacer algo: «If you cannot help worrying».

en.q: If you ask me, I _____ a young boy ought to think himself lucky when he gets such a place as this.
en.r: «I should think» = diría que, me parece que (opinión prudente, uso británico).

en.q: I _____ that airport staff would have told you that OPODO was responsible for your predicament,
en.r: «I rather doubt that…» = más bien dudo que… «rather» como adverbio de grado delante del verbo.

en.q: Dear Megan, I thought you _____ that one week into my diet change I am down six pounds and feel better already.
en.r: «I thought you would like to know» = pensé que te gustaría saber (would like en estilo indirecto/pasado).

en.q: As a condition of release, the prisoner was forced to sign a pledge that he _____ all forms of violence and terrorism.
en.r: Estilo indirecto: compromiso futuro desde el pasado → «would + inf» (that he would reject).

en.q: Both bus and train _____ 3 hours between Montreal and Quebec City, so either option _____ fine.
en.r: Dos sujetos unidos con «both… and» = plural (take). «either option» = singular (is).

en.q: Three top executives _____ following allegations of sexual harassment.
en.r: «make sb do» en pasiva lleva «to»: «were made to resign». El adverbio de modo va al final.

en.q: Carrying bottles full of water in this area is not _____ .
en.r: «be allowed» en pasiva sin «to» cuando no sigue verbo: «is not allowed». «let» no se usa en pasiva.

en.q: Her coach recommends that she _____ one more time.
en.r: Tras «recommend that» se usa la forma base (she try) o «should + inf» (she should try). Aquí la opción válida es «should try».

en.q: Are you going to drive now? I'd rather _____ . You look a bit too tired.
en.r: «I'd rather + sujeto + pasado simple» = preferiría que no lo hicieras: «you didn't».

en.q: In many games, diplomatic prowess can be an asset, but very rarely _____ a strategy game that relied on physical skills.
en.r: Adverbio restrictivo al principio (very rarely, seldom, never) → inversión del auxiliar: «very rarely would one find».

en.q: _____ she was pregnant was something everyone could tell.
en.r: Oración sustantiva como sujeto: «That she was pregnant was something…» = el hecho de que… Se introduce con «That».

en.q: _____ matters is not _____ you hear on the news, but what you make out of this information.
en.r: «What» = lo que, en ambas posiciones: «What matters is not what you hear…».

en.q: At Christmas, fresh prawns may cost up to 80€ _____ kilo.
en.r: Precio por unidad: «80€ a kilo» (a = por cada). También «per kilo».

en.q: If you want to succeed _____ , of course, necessary to work hard.
en.r: Sujeto vacío «it» + adjetivo + to inf: «it is necessary to work hard».

en.q: Yesterday, I met a neighbour I used to play tennis _____ .
en.r: Relativo omitido con la preposición al final: «a neighbour (who) I used to play tennis with». Si pusieras «with whom», no repetirías «with».

en.q: Do you remember _____ ?
o: the place where did he live
en.r: Pregunta indirecta/oración relativa: orden afirmativo sin do: «the place he lived in».

en.q: Debating in democracies is necessary _____ as it helps people exchange their ideas.
en.r: «inasmuch as» = en la medida en que, puesto que (formal). Estructura fija con «as».

en.q: _____ a lot of progress has been done already, we still need to work hard to reach our objectives.
en.r: «Though» = aunque (concesión): aunque se ha avanzado mucho, aún hay que trabajar.

en.q: There have been reports of animals in the zoo imitating the behaviour of other species _____ they are housed.
en.r: Preposición delante del relativo para cosas/animales: «species with which they are housed» (= que comparten alojamiento con ellos).

en.q: The book I read provides an explanation _____ how technology is changing society.
en.r: «an explanation as to + wh-» = una explicación sobre/acerca de cómo… («as to» = en cuanto a).

en.q: A new survey analyses smoking habits and the degree to _____ prohibition policies work.
en.r: «the degree to which» = el grado en que (preposición + which).

en.q: Earlier this year Spotify announced a(n) _____ on the use of copyrighted music.
en.r: «crackdown on» = medidas enérgicas contra algo.

en.q: Although he tried to look honest and sincere, no one was taken _____ by his excuses.
en.r: «be taken in (by)» = dejarse engañar por algo.

en.q: Apparently, the job includes a huge amount of day-to-day _____ .
en.r: «administration» = trabajo administrativo (day-to-day administration).

en.q: The everyday footwear of provincial women at that time was particularly _____ .
en.r: Prefijo negativo: «inelegant». (in- con elegant; «unelegant» no es estándar).

en.q: A parent’s lack of social skills has far-reaching negative effects on their _____ mental health.
en.r: «offspring» = descendencia, hijos. Genitivo: their offspring's mental health.

en.q: It is an extraordinary durable paint made of acrylic resin for a(n) _____ result.
en.r: «everlasting» = duradero, eterno (prefijo ever-).

en.q: There were anti-police demonstrations after the shooting and two policemen and three _____ were wounded.
en.r: Plural de compuestos: el plural va en el sustantivo principal: «passers-by» (transeúntes).

en.q: Lots of _____ players often get cheated at online casinos.
en.r: Prefijo negativo de experienced: «inexperienced».

en.q: The future is _____ so you should have hope.
en.r: Prefijo negativo de knowable: «unknowable» (incognoscible).

en.q: The Internet has led to faster and more effective _____ of information.
en.r: «dissemination of information» = difusión de la información (colocación).

en.q: As _____ in the introduction not all big companies reacted the same way in the face of the economic crisis.
en.r: «As outlined in…» = como se resume/expone en… «outline» = esbozar.

en.q: Even if women _____ men at most Western Universities they are less likely to reach managerial positions.
en.r: «outnumber» = superar en número (prefijo out- = superar: outperform, outgrow).

en.q: His mother had given him a diamond ring, a family _____ for his fiancée.
en.r: «heirloom» = reliquia familiar, objeto heredado.

en.q: The doctor told him that his problems derived from _____ shoes.
en.r: «ill-fitting» = que no sienta/ajusta bien (zapatos). Prefijo ill- = mal (ill-advised, ill-equipped).

en.q: Only two out of ten senators had the _____ and courage to defy the president.
en.r: «foresight» = previsión, visión de futuro.

en.q: People develop mixed feelings about organizations that they perceive as powerful, _____ or undemocratic.
en.r: Prefijo negativo de approachable: «unapproachable» (inaccesible).

en.q: Mark was made to quit his job because he didn’t get along with his _____ workers.
en.r: «fellow workers» = compañeros de trabajo (fellow + sustantivo = compañero de…).

en.q: I’d suggest you kept your emails _____ . People do not have the time to read long emails.
en.r: «concise» = conciso, breve. «laconic» se aplica a personas que hablan poco.

en.q: Cats do not _____ as much for human company as dogs do.
en.r: «care for» = sentir aprecio/interés por algo. «not care much for» = no gustar mucho.

en.q: Most of the poorer areas are on the _____ of the town, away from fancy shops.
en.r: «the outskirts» = las afueras de una ciudad.

en.q: Brian is a very _____ child and cries easily.
en.r: «sensitive» = sensible, que se emociona/ofende fácilmente. «sensible» es FALSO AMIGO = sensato.

en.q: The manager said that the company had all the necessary _____ for training.
en.r: «resources» = recursos (medios disponibles). Colocación: necessary resources for training.

en.q: The latest opinion _____ has predicted new trends in the local elections next spring.
en.r: «opinion poll» = encuesta/sondeo de opinión.

en.q: You really must _____ your papers. Your desk is a real mess.
en.r: «sort out» = ordenar, organizar (papeles); también resolver un problema.

en.q: Wildlife biologists try to _____ the trust of the animals they want to study.
en.r: «win sb's trust» = ganarse la confianza de alguien (colocación con win).

en.q: Can you _____ exactly what the problems is?
en.r: «pin down» = precisar, identificar con exactitud.

en.q: The defendant not only _____ sexual intercourse with the daughter on the evening charged in the information, but likewise o n any other occasion.
en.r: «deny + -ing» (nunca deny to): «denied having (had)…». Con «not only» la estructura es: not only denied X but (also) Y.

en.q: If you weren't so stubborn, you _____ and be perfectly safe and carefree now.
en.r: Condicional mixto: condición presente irreal (no fueras tan testarudo = rasgo actual) → consecuencia pasada «would have rectified» + consecuencia presente «(would) be safe now». El segundo «would» se omite por elipsis.

en.q: If Michael _____ wishes to receive her tweets, he should block her.
en.r: «no longer» = ya no (va entre sujeto y verbo): «If Michael no longer wishes…». «any longer / anymore» van al final y con verbo negativo.

en.q: _____ was just _____ we needed to finish our project.
en.r: Cleft sentence: «That was just what we needed» = eso era justo lo que necesitábamos. «what» = lo que (incluye el antecedente).

en.q: When my son came back home I could tell he _____ football by the deplorable state of his shoes.
en.r: Pasado perfecto continuo para una actividad previa cuyas huellas se ven en el pasado (por el estado de sus zapatos se notaba que había estado jugando).

en.q: For a good two hours I stood and watched _____ for victims amongst the rubble.
en.r: «watch + objeto + -ing» = observar una acción en curso: «watched the firefighters searching».

en.q: We started the move at 9 am, than at 1 pm we _____ lunch.
en.r: «stop + -ing» = dejar de hacer algo; luego «had lunch» en pasado (paramos de trabajar y comimos).

en.q: We hope the strike _____ by the time you read this.
en.r: «by the time + presente» → futuro perfecto (pasivo): «will have been called off» (ya se habrá desconvocado).

en.q: How should I deal with any questions I'd rather _____ ?
en.r: «I'd rather + past perfect» expresa deseo sobre algo pasado o ya planteado (preguntas que preferiría que no me hubieran hecho). La clave oficial es «hadn't been asked».

en.q: _____ a growing concern for public safety, emphasis has also been on environmental awareness.
en.r: «Alongside» = junto con, además de (dos preocupaciones a la vez).

en.q: It’s important to _____ before the autumn. Let’s find a good, reliable company straight away.
en.r: Causativa «get + objeto + participio» = encargar el arreglo a una empresa: «get the roof repaired».

en.q: If Alfie _____ my wife about my affair I’d certainly be much better off now.
en.r: Condicional mixto: condición pasada (if he hadn't told, past perfect) → resultado presente (I'd be better off now).

en.q: The funeral is this weekend. I need _____ right away.
en.r: «need to get + objeto + participio» = necesito que me limpien el traje en seco (causativa).

en.q: Poor Mary Jo. Look at her eyes. She looks as though she _____ .
en.r: «look as though + presente perfecto continuo» cuando la apariencia es real y actual (tiene los ojos rojos porque ha estado llorando).

en.q: Marcus is a wolf in sheep's clothing. I'd sooner live under a bridge than _____ with him.
en.r: «would sooner / would rather + infinitivo sin to … than + infinitivo sin to»: I'd sooner live… than work.

en.q: The Board of Education is committed to _____ any situation in which the existence of interests may call into question the integrity of the management of the school district.
o: the fact that should be avoided
en.r: «be committed to + -ing»: «to» es preposición → «committed to avoiding».

en.q: Nothing is doing _____ near as much as technology to help improve life expectancy.
en.r: «nowhere / not anywhere near as much as» = ni de lejos tanto como. Con «Nothing» ya negativo se usa «anywhere».

en.q: The mother asked her children not to leave the car, unless told _____ .
en.r: «unless told otherwise» = salvo que se les diga lo contrario (expresión fija).

en.q: No one knows the reason _____ Peter is so upset with us.
en.r: «the reason why + oración» = la razón por la que.

en.q: An open attitude helps language learners _____ as much as other factors.
en.r: «nearly as much as» = casi tanto como.

en.q: Little _____ about the origin of life.
en.r: Adverbio negativo al inicio («Little» = muy poco) → inversión: «Little do we know».

en.q: A good playground is one _____ children can use their imagination.
en.r: Relativo de lugar: «one where children can use…» (= in which).

en.q: There are almost _____ differences between twin brothers.
en.r: «almost no + sustantivo» = casi ninguna diferencia. «none» es pronombre (no va con sustantivo detrás).

en.q: The president voted in favour and other Members of Parliament did _____ .
en.r: «did likewise» = hicieron lo mismo.

en.q: Our boss gave us clear instructions. If you believe _____ , you should go tell her.
en.r: «believe otherwise» = creer lo contrario.

en.q: My partner and I _____ have twin sisters.
en.r: «both» va entre sujeto y verbo: «My partner and I both have…».

en.q: _____ the speaker was getting at has been also addressed in many forums: the meaning of life.
en.r: «What the speaker was getting at» = lo que el orador quería decir. «get at» = insinuar/querer decir.

en.q: Mark was _____ when he heard the company hadn’t renewed his contract after ten years of working for them.
en.r: «devastated» = destrozado, hundido (emocionalmente).

en.q: Economists should not be _____ by small signs of improvement. The overall perspective is still negative.
en.r: «be misled by» = dejarse engañar/confundir por algo (mislead → misled).

en.q: Instead of feeling ashamed, many young offenders tend to _____ about their crimes to their friends.
en.r: «boast about» = presumir, jactarse de algo.

en.q: Simple _____ wounds may be left uncovered so they dry and heal.
en.r: Prefijo negativo de infected: «uninfected» (no infectadas).

en.q: Before the surgery, do not apply any _____ cream or talcum powder.
en.r: «deodorant» = desodorante (de- + odour). Ojo, no «desodorant».

en.q: Fans showed their _____ at the delay by booing loudly.
en.r: Prefijo negativo de pleasure: «displeasure» (desagrado).

en.q: The use of reproductive technology to service a preference for male offspring has created an artificial gender _____ , notably in Asian countries.
en.r: «imbalance» = desequilibrio (prefijo im- delante de b).

en.q: In a job interview it is important to _____ yourself from other candidates.
en.r: «differentiate yourself from» = diferenciarse de. «differ» es intransitivo (no lleva yourself).

en.q: Caregivers may feel _____ by other family members if they don’t show respect and love.
en.r: «underappreciated» = infravalorado, poco reconocido (prefijo under- = insuficiente).

en.q: The immigrants that were admitted to hospital were _____ due to a recurrent lack of food.
en.r: «malnourished» = desnutrido (prefijo mal- = mal).

en.q: The Jews have sometimes been accused of reacting _____ to the Nazis.
en.r: Adverbio «submissively» = sumisamente.

en.q: Jane told me her husband, _____ his doctor’s orders, continues smoking.
en.r: «disregarding» = haciendo caso omiso de (dis- + regard).

en.q: The problem is the continuous _____ between the social and political forces implied.
en.r: «disjointedness» = desconexión, falta de coherencia.

en.q: The police _____ and stamped out the unrest.
en.r: «counterattack» = contraatacar (prefijo counter- = contra).

en.q: The staff was warned that even simple procedures caused _____ in small children, too young to understand explanations.
en.r: «uproar» = alboroto, escándalo.

en.q: After some months she became so sick that she needed _____ care.
en.r: «round-the-clock care» = cuidados las 24 horas.

en.q: My brother has set his _____ on becoming a good school teacher.
en.r: Expresión «set one's heart on (doing) something» = desear algo con todas sus fuerzas.

en.q: The sign near the hotel says “NO _____ ”. We’d better try somewhere else.
en.r: «No vacancies» = completo (cartel de hotel sin habitaciones libres).

en.q: A very common type of mirage is the _____ of water in the desert.
en.r: «illusion» = ilusión óptica (el espejismo es la ilusión de agua en el desierto).

en.q: In Spain there is a total _____ on smoking in public places.
en.r: «a ban on» = prohibición de (total ban on smoking).

en.q: If I go out in the sun, I come _____ in a rash.
en.r: «come out in a rash/spots» = salirle a uno un sarpullido/granos.

en.q: My grandfather had this _____ of smoking a pipe after each meal.
en.r: «habit of + -ing» = costumbre de hacer algo. «costume» = disfraz (falso amigo).

en.q: Many Americans can trace their _____ back to their arrival as immigrants from Ireland.
en.r: «trace one's ancestors/ancestry back to» = remontar su ascendencia a…

en.q: The most intriguing details about the closure of the magazine came from an unnamed _____ .
en.r: «an unnamed source» = una fuente anónima (periodismo).

en.q: Some taxi drivers consider that bike routes _____ motor traffic in cities.
en.r: «clog» = atascar, obstruir (el tráfico).

en.q: I like shopping in local second hand stores because the staff are so _____ .
en.r: «approachable» = accesible, cercano (persona fácil de tratar).

en.q: Ten minutes into our conversation she declared that she wished she _____ back in time to tell her former manager to leave her alone.
en.r: «wish + could + inf» = deseo de tener una capacidad (ojalá pudiera volver atrás). Se refiere a su deseo actual en el momento de hablar.

en.q: During the winter, the young scouts _____ cut trees and carry logs.
en.r: «make sb do» en pasiva → «be made to do»: «were made to cut trees».

en.q: The witness claimed to know _____ had happened.
en.r: «know exactly what + oración» = saber exactamente lo que había pasado.

en.q: A well-deserved medal. If not for the Chief Inspector, the plotters _____ with it.
en.r: Condicional tipo 3 (de no ser por el inspector, se habrían salido con la suya): «would have got away with it».

en.q: It goes without saying I wouldn’t have come here last weekend if I _____ .
en.r: Condicional tipo 3 con elipsis: «if I hadn't been keen to (come)». Se mantiene el «to» para no repetir el verbo.

en.q: Over the next few months an important survey _____ .
en.r: Presente continuo pasivo para una acción en curso durante un período: «a survey is being carried out».

en.q: Acts of terrorism, in spite of what _____ , are the most difficult way of achieving the terrorists' objectives.
en.r: «what» como sujeto singular + presente perfecto pasivo: «in spite of what has been said».

en.q: Vermont Gas is seeking to use funds they promised _____ until the pipeline was completed.
en.r: Estilo indirecto: promesa en pasado → «would»: «funds they promised they wouldn't touch».

en.q: The distillery industry is growing in Frederick County, Maryland, and locals _____ more businesses.
en.r: Futuro continuo «will be seeing» = cosa que ocurrirá como desarrollo natural (los vecinos verán más negocios).

en.q: The European Commission, _____ referred as “the EC”, is a complex institution.
en.r: «hereinafter referred to as» = en adelante denominado (lenguaje formal/legal).

en.q: Teachers are usually concerned with _____ students have learned from their lessons or not.
en.r: «whether … or not» = si … o no (cuando hay alternativa explícita con «or not»).

en.q: I _____ your nephews will be delighted with their presents.
en.r: «I should think» = me imagino/supongo que (opinión).

en.q: Stop it! _____ your knuckles is beginning to get on my nerves.
en.r: El sujeto de un gerundio se expresa con posesivo: «Your cracking your knuckles is…» (que crujas los nudillos).

en.q: If you do the cooking then I’m the one that’ll have to clean the house, _____ ?
en.r: Question tag con «I'm»: «…, aren't I?».

en.q: The doctor recommends that the patients _____ the new treatment _____ very small doses.
en.r: «recommend that + sujeto + be + participio» (subjuntivo pasivo): «that the patients undergoing the treatment be given very small doses».

en.q: I'll always remember _____ those football stickers back when I was a kid.
en.r: «remember + -ing» = recordar algo que ya pasó (coleccionar cromos de niño).

en.q: Caffeine has proven to have some health benefits, _____ alcohol hasn’t.
en.r: «whereas» = mientras que (contraste entre dos hechos).

en.q: Very rarely _____ my parents argue when I was little.
en.r: Adverbio restrictivo al inicio (Very rarely, Seldom, Never) → inversión con auxiliar: «Very rarely did I see…». Pasado porque se refiere a cuando era pequeño.

en.q: This parking lot is private. You can’t park _____ a valid permit.
en.r: «unless + sujeto + verbo» (= if you don't have): «unless you have a valid permit». Sin inversión.

en.q: _____ the lack of time, the meeting had to be put off and postponed.
en.r: «Owing to + sustantivo» = debido a. «Because» necesitaría «of».

en.q: The waiter asked the customers if _____ they wanted.
en.r: Pregunta indirecta con «what» = lo que: «if that was what they wanted».

en.q: Are there _____ things as ghosts?
en.r: «such things as» = cosas tales como: «Are there such things as ghosts?» (¿existen cosas como los fantasmas?).

en.q: We had to work really hard _____ miss our deadline.
en.r: Finalidad negativa: «so as not to / in order not to + inf». El «not» va ANTES del «to».

en.q: The media brought up the CV _____ the politician lied about his degree.
en.r: Preposición + relativo: «the CV in which the politician lied» (en el que mintió).

en.q: The proposal was a call to change the company’s focus towards local markets, _____ focusing it on global economy.
en.r: «as opposed to + -ing» = en lugar de / en contraposición a.

en.q: The parents gave permission _____ their child to be examined by a doctor.
en.r: «permission for sb to do sth» = permiso para que alguien haga algo.

en.q: Science has been influenced by advances in technology _____ more sophisticated computers and tools are being used.
en.r: «in that» = en el sentido de que, dado que.

en.q: It's been raining for two days and it doesn't look like it will let _____ today.
en.r: «let up» = amainar, remitir (lluvia, tormenta).

en.q: When we crossed the canyon, we stopped for a rest and we could take _____ the wonderful views.
en.r: «take in» = contemplar, asimilar (vistas, información).

en.q: It’s hard to find anything on his desk as it is always _____ .
en.r: «cluttered» = abarrotado, lleno de trastos (mesa, habitación).

en.q: When the girl opened her eyes she felt she was in a(n) _____ environment.
en.r: Prefijo negativo de familiar: «unfamiliar» (desconocido).

en.q: You have been _____ helpful any time we were in trouble.
en.r: Delante del adjetivo «helpful» hace falta un ADVERBIO: «unbelievably helpful». Prefijo un-.

en.q: You have to pay extra attention to the ends of your hair, especially if it is _____ or longer.
en.r: Adjetivo compuesto «shoulder-length» = (pelo) a la altura de los hombros.

en.q: Alexander the Great, it is said, made many _____ attempts to untie some of the knots, but finally becoming enraged at his want of success, drew his sword and cut the cord.
en.r: «ineffectual» = ineficaz, infructuoso.

en.q: When Sean left the pub after spending there the whole afternoon he was in a _____ state.
en.r: «pitiful» = lamentable, penoso (estado). «piteous» = que inspira compasión (lamento).

en.q: Her excuse was that she had been _____ detained on urgent business.
en.r: Adverbio «unavoidably» = inevitablemente («unavoidably detained» = retenido sin remedio).

en.q: The international community must uphold the international rule of law and redouble its efforts to resolve _____ disputes.
en.r: «long-standing disputes» = conflictos de larga duración.

en.q: Surprisingly Pamela’s education was a _____ when she tried to find a job because she was overqualified.
en.r: «liability» = carga, desventaja (lo contrario de asset).

en.q: Nobody understood why they chose to live in such a _____ neighbourhood.
en.r: Prefijo negativo de reputable: «disreputable» (de mala fama).

en.q: Our policy comprises a _____ approach spanning innovation, safety and environmental awareness.
en.r: Sufijo -fold = multiplicado por: «threefold approach» = enfoque triple.

en.q: To cheer her up it is a good idea to take her to a restaurant or some other _____ .
en.r: «outing» = salida, excursión (ir a un restaurante u otro sitio).

en.q: Frederick the Great was _____ for his military victories and his masterful strategy and tactics.
en.r: «noteworthy» = digno de mención, notable.

en.q: They were awakened by an _____ smell of gas.
en.r: «overpowering» = intenso, abrumador (olor).

en.q: The press informed of a new oil _____ at a BP platform off the coast of Scotland.
en.r: «oil leak» = fuga de petróleo. («spill» sería el sustantivo; «spilt» es participio.)

en.q: It was a very tempting offer, but after considering the _____ , I accepted it.
en.r: «downsides» = inconvenientes, desventajas. Aunque tenía inconvenientes, lo aceptó.

en.q: The characters of local farmers in the film are _____ by people who actually lived there.
en.r: Personajes «played by» = interpretados por (actores).

en.q: Working eight hours alone in an observation tower is hard, lonely and, on _____ , even depressing.
en.r: «on occasion» = a veces, de vez en cuando (expresión fija, sin artículo).

en.q: Some doctors’ _____ to backache is to prescribe painkillers.
en.r: «approach to + sustantivo» = enfoque/manera de abordar algo.

en.q: Despite living in a _____ town in the mountains, he managed to work effectively from home.
en.r: «remote town» = pueblo remoto/aislado.

en.q: They tried to _____ their misconduct, but the police found some incriminating documents.
en.r: «cover up» = encubrir (un delito, un error).

en.q: Just providing clean water for washing is a simple way to _____ eye diseases.
en.r: «combat diseases» = combatir enfermedades.

en.q: The parents started to worry when they lost _____ of their children in the crowded streets.
en.r: «lose sight of» = perder de vista.

en.q: Some public radio stations operate at a _____ and depend on the help of subsidies.
en.r: «operate at a loss» = funcionar con pérdidas. «lose» es verbo; «loose» = suelto.

en.q: I hate people who _____ the ending of every film they have seen.
en.r: «will» para hábitos característicos (a menudo molestos): gente que siempre te destripa el final.

en.q: There are rumours that Renault may be leaving Portland. It would be a pity if the staff _____ because of this.
en.r: «were to + inf» en condicional hipotético futuro (si llegaran a…), en pasiva: «if the staff were to be laid off».

en.q: Young children today seem to be _____ when we were kids.
en.r: Comparativo con elipsis: «cleverer than (we were) when we were kids». Adjetivo corto de 2 sílabas acabado en -er → -er.

en.q: Just as you arrived, I _____ ready to go out.
en.r: Pasado continuo para una acción en curso interrumpida por otra (just as you arrived): «I was getting ready».

en.q: I spoke to Michael last night and he says he _____ while he was on the swimming pool of the hotel
en.r: Causativa «have sth done» para algo que te pasa (sin querer): «he had his phone stolen» = le robaron el móvil.

en.q: The cathedral seems to have been _____ construction for quite some time
en.r: «under construction» = en construcción (expresión fija con under).

en.q: Soy is a very important _____ in Brazil
en.r: «crop» = cultivo (la soja es un cultivo importante). «livestock/cattle» = ganado.

en.q: They’re staying in my house for the time _____ .
en.r: «for the time being» = de momento, por ahora (expresión fija).

en.q: The police is still trying to _____ out how they were able to steal so easily,
en.r: «figure out» = averiguar, entender cómo.

en.q: The population is taken serious _____ against their betrayal politicians, Finally.
en.r: «take serious action against» = tomar medidas serias contra (la transcripción oficial tiene erratas; la colocación es «take action»).

en.q: _____ of globalization contend that it fosters global cooperation and development.
en.r: «Proponents of» = defensores de (los que afirman que fomenta la cooperación). «Detractors/Opponents» = detractores.

en.q: Despite her initial interest in pursuing a career in medical research, she ultimately found her calling in direct patient care and is now a respected _____ with a focus on integrative medicine.
en.r: «physician» = médico (general/clínico), centrado en la atención al paciente. Falso amigo: NO es físico (physicist).

en.q: Every week, the local _____ is bustling with activity as vendors display an eclectic mix of antiques, vintage clothing, and miscellaneous treasures for bargain hunters to explore.
en.r: «street market» = mercadillo callejero con antigüedades y ropa vintage (clave oficial).

en.q: The _____ carefully hemmed the wedding gown to fit the bride perfectly.
en.r: «seamstress» = costurera (hem = coger el bajo de una prenda).

en.q: Have you considered applying for a job with the _____ service?.
en.r: «civil service» = la administración pública / funcionariado.

en.q: Attendance at the museum has _____ , significantly since they launched new exhibitions.
en.r: Presente perfecto de «rise» (intransitivo): rise – rose – RISEN. «raise» necesita objeto.

en.q: Despite the unpredictable climate, farmers _____ their fields, relying on advanced technology to anticipate weather pattern and mitigate potential risks.
en.r: Presente perfecto continuo para una actividad que empezó en el pasado y continúa (siguen sembrando a pesar del clima).

en.q: Rebecca didn’t deserve _____ punished quite so severely, if you ask me.
en.r: «deserve + to + inf»; en pasiva «deserve to be punished».

en.q: At the event there were several families, many of _____ children were eagerly participating in the activities.
en.r: «whose» = cuyo/cuyos (posesión): «many of whose children» = muchos de cuyos hijos.

en.q: I think you should face up _____ the fact our relationship’s over,
en.r: Phrasal verb «face up to» = afrontar, aceptar (un hecho desagradable).

en.q: Please let’s continue tomorrow, shall we? It’s to much information for me to _____ in in one go.
en.r: «take in» = asimilar información.

en.q: How dare you accuse me _____ !.
en.r: «accuse sb of + -ing» = acusar a alguien de hacer algo.

en.q: Scarcely had Matt begun his new job _____ he decided to resign.
en.r: «Scarcely/Hardly had + sujeto + participio + WHEN…» = apenas había… cuando. Con «No sooner» se usa «than».

en.q: Whenever she goes out, she stays at _____ .
en.r: Genitivo para la casa/tienda de alguien: «at Maria's» (= at Maria's house).

en.q: “We were at the ACDC concert last week” “Were you? So _____ !”
en.r: «So + auxiliar + sujeto» = yo también (acuerdo positivo): «So was I».

en.q: The _____ was caused by war in the región.
en.r: «famine» = hambruna (causada por la guerra). «drought» = sequía.

en.q: I got lost in the city, _____ being quite good at navigating unfamiliar pieces.
en.r: «despite + -ing» = a pesar de (ser buena orientándome). «although» necesitaría sujeto y verbo.

en.q: My jeans _____ in the wash and they’re too small for me now.
en.r: «shrink – shrank – shrunk» = encoger (ropa al lavar).

en.q: I’ve never seen a man so _____ to his family as Mark is.
en.r: «dedicated to» = entregado/dedicado a (su familia).

en.q: Although he would have preferred to carry on working, my dad _____ his career in order to have children.
en.r: «sacrifice one's career» = sacrificar su carrera.

en.q: The new CEO Will take _____ the company’s operations next mouth.
en.r: «take over» = asumir el control/la dirección de algo.

en.q: The Magic Box is a famous tennis _____ in Madrid
en.r: «tennis court» = pista de tenis. «pitch» = campo (fútbol), «rink» = pista de hielo, «course» = campo de golf.

en.q: In summer, I get _____ from the chlorine in the pools.
en.r: «pinkeye» = conjuntivitis (por el cloro). «hoarse» = afónico.

en.q: The south of the city has long been its most _____ area with incomes well below average.
en.r: «impoverished» = empobrecido (ingresos por debajo de la media). Los otros = rico.

en.q: It was time to change the _____ on the car as they had worn out.
en.r: «tires/tyres» = neumáticos (se desgastan → worn out).

en.q: _____ , we would have chosen an alternate route.
o: Had we been informed about road closure
If our teem was better informed
Did we know about the road closure
en.r: Condicional tipo 3 con inversión: «Had we been informed…, we would have chosen…».

en.q: “ I’m not the manager here, It’s his responsibility to deal with _____ , not mine!”
en.r: Genitivo de plural regular: apóstrofo DESPUÉS de la s: «customers' complaints».

en.q: Benefits _____ slightly next year, although we don’t predict any job losses.
en.r: Pasiva personal: «Benefits are expected to fall» = se espera que los beneficios bajen.

en.q: No sooner _____ everyone started speaking ill of him.
en.r: «No sooner had + sujeto + participio + than…» = nada más… cuando. Inversión obligatoria.

en.q: Not until we have no choice _____ the business down,
en.r: «Not until…» al inicio → inversión en la oración principal: «Not until we have no choice will we close…».

en.q: Make sure you mix the ingredients well, _____ you might get lumps in your cake.
en.r: «otherwise» = si no, de lo contrario.

en.q: The murders were convicted and sentenced _____ six months in prisión.
en.r: «sentence sb to + pena» = condenar a alguien a (seis meses de prisión).

en.q: I wouldn’t call her a friend, she is more like a/an _____ really.
en.r: «acquaintance» = conocido (no llega a amigo).

en.q: Luigi works at a _____ in Rome.
o: None of the above are correct
en.r: Genitivo para nombrar una tienda/negocio: «a travel agent's» (= la oficina del agente de viajes), igual que «at the baker's».

en.q: When Yanis arrived, he soon _____ at all his jokes.
en.r: Causativa «have + persona + -ing» = conseguir que alguien esté haciendo algo: «he had everyone laughing» (hizo reír a todos).

en.q: You know what they _____ : different strokes for different folks!
en.r: Expresión fija «You know what they say: …» = ya sabes lo que dicen (para citar un refrán).

en.q: Do you believe in that old _____ about not walking under a ladder?
en.r: «superstition» = superstición (no pasar bajo una escalera).

en.q: What’s the _____ number fo road accidents in Rome per year?
en.r: «approximate number» = número aproximado.

en.q: How many students _____ from university totally unable to spell even simple English words correctly?
en.r: «graduate from university» = licenciarse/graduarse en la universidad.

en.q: To maintain a healthy lifestyle, it’s important to _____ excessive consumption of sugary drinks.
en.r: «avoid + sustantivo/-ing» = evitar (consumir en exceso). «prevent» = impedir que ocurra.

en.q: After examining the X-rays, they told me that _____ was necessary to repair the fractured bone.
en.r: «surgery» (incontable) = cirugía/operación. «an operation» llevaría artículo.

en.q: After recovering well, the patient was _____ from the hospital and advised to rest at home.
en.r: «be discharged from hospital» = recibir el alta.

en.q: He broke his arm and had to wear a _____ for several weeks.
en.r: «cast» = escayola (en inglés americano; en británico «plaster cast»). «crutch» = muleta.

en.q: The fashion show showcased a variety of colourful and diverse _____ ranging from casual wear to haute couture creations.
en.r: «garments» = prendas de vestir. «cloths» = trapos/telas; «attire» es incontable.

en.q: The _____ situation in the country has led to job losses and financial uncertain for many people.
en.r: «economic» = relativo a la economía (economic situation). «economical» = ahorrador, que gasta poco.

en.q: The children love rock. _____ are covered in rock band posters.
o: None of the above are correct
en.r: Con cosas/partes de un lugar se prefiere «the X of Y»: «The walls of their bedroom». El genitivo 's se usa sobre todo con personas.

en.q: Given her Italian heritage, whenever she travels to Italy, she usually stays at her _____ .
en.r: Genitivo singular de persona: «her grandmother's historic villa» (apóstrofo antes de la s).

en.q: I have _____ my children with meticulous care and unwavering dedication.
en.r: «raise children» = criar hijos (raise es transitivo; raise-raised-raised). «rise» es intransitivo.

en.q: I _____ it’s going to rain tonight, don’t you?
en.r: «I reckon (that)…» = creo, me parece (informal).

en.q: Thanks for thinking of us, but those kinds of political gatherings don’t align with my political views. I’m afraid I’ll have to _____ your kind invitation.
en.r: «decline an invitation» = rechazar educadamente una invitación.

en.q: This is not the real exam, this is a _____ exam. It’s just to train us for the real one.
en.r: «mock exam» = simulacro de examen.

en.q: I’m in a real _____ and just don’t know what to do.
en.r: «be in a dilemma» = estar en un dilema (no saber qué hacer).

en.q: Luckily, only _____ of the medicine got spilt.
en.r: «a little» + incontable = un poco (matiz positivo: «afortunadamente solo se derramó un poco»). «little» = poco (negativo); «few/a few» son para contables.

en.q: _____ getting a pet snake?
o: Has James really been thinking that
en.r: Presente continuo con «think of + -ing» = estar planteándose hacer algo: «Is James really thinking of getting…?».

en.q: “I can´t stand this hot weather” “No, _____ . Dreadful, isn´t it?”
en.r: Acuerdo con una frase NEGATIVA: «Neither/Nor + auxiliar + sujeto» = yo tampoco: «neither can I».

en.q: I feel _____ to inform the committee that the referendum results are not positive
en.r: «feel it + sustantivo/adjetivo + to + inf»: «I feel it my duty to inform» (it anticipa el infinitivo).

en.q: _____ quickly we ran, just couldn´t catch the pickpocket.
en.r: «However + adjetivo/adverbio + sujeto + verbo» = por muy … que: «However quickly we ran» (por muy rápido que corriéramos).

en.q: She won the election _____ all the odds.
en.r: Expresión fija «against all the odds» = contra todo pronóstico.

en.q: The politician denied _____ any details of the confidential meeting with the press.
en.r: «deny + -ing» (nunca «deny to»): «denied discussing».

en.q: I read somewhere that the youngest _____ in a family is often the funniest
en.r: «sibling» = hermano/a (genérico). «spouse» = cónyuge.

en.q: There _____ around 8.1 billion people living in the world today
en.r: Pasiva con «there»: «There are said to be…» = se dice que hay…

en.q: Sarah decided to buy a hybrid car because it was more _____ in terms of fuel consumption.
en.r: «economical» = económico, que ahorra (combustible). «economic» = relativo a la economía.

en.q: The appendicitis operation left a _____ on his abdomen for life
en.r: «scar» = cicatriz. «bruise» = moratón; «blister» = ampolla.

en.q: As a specialist in prenatal and postnatal care, she is highly respected in her field and excels in her role as a dedicated _____ , providing essential support to mothers throughout their pregnancy journey.
en.r: «midwife» = matrona/comadrona (atención prenatal y posparto).

en.q: The employee decided to refuse _____ the contract until further clarification was provided.
en.r: «refuse + to + inf» = negarse a hacer algo.

en.q: Deciding whether or not to allocate grants for training is a _____ decision, but you can contest the decision in court.
en.r: Adjetivo «political decision». «politic» = prudente; «politically» es adverbio.

en.q: Is it really the first time _____ in first class?
en.r: «It's the first time + presente perfecto»: «the first time you've ever flown».

en.q: The _____ I don´t understand is why she lets him get away with it.
en.r: «The thing I don't understand is…» = lo que no entiendo es…

en.q: The company is expected _____ a healthy profit this year.
en.r: Pasiva personal: «is expected to make» = se espera que obtenga.

en.q: We´re still trying to _____ together exactly what went wrong.
en.r: «piece together» = reconstruir (encajar las piezas de lo que pasó).

en.q: Let me mull this _____ for a while and then I´ll get back to you.
en.r: «mull over» = darle vueltas, reflexionar sobre algo.

en.q: The kids suggested _____ popcorn for the film tonight. What do you think?
en.r: «suggest + -ing» (o suggest that we get). Nunca «suggest to + inf».

en.q: Why don´t you have a doctor _____ at your arm if it´s hurting you?
en.r: Causativa «have + persona + infinitivo sin to»: «have a doctor look at your arm».

en.q: Although it had been explained really well, I still had trouble _____ the details of how VOR systems work.
en.r: «have trouble + -ing» = tener dificultades para hacer algo. «grasp» = comprender. (comprending no existe; es «comprehending»).

en.q: I really needed a bathroom but didn't know _____ .
en.kn: A isn't wrong but sounds less natural
en.r: «where to find one» = dónde encontrar uno (wh- + infinitivo). La clave indica que «where one was» no es incorrecta, pero suena menos natural.

en.q: The storm had moved from Portugal into France, propelled by powerful _____ winds.
en.r: Vientos: adjetivo en -erly para la dirección DE DONDE viene el viento: «southwesterly winds». «southwestern» = situado en el suroeste.

en.q: Lisa couldn't believe that Jack still hadn't _____ the fact that she liked him!
en.r: «catch onto something» = darse cuenta de algo. «catch on» sin «to» no lleva objeto; «catched» no existe.

en.q: The academy saw a huge reduction in its _____ numbers due to Edu's negative publicity.
en.r: «uptake» = número de personas que se apuntan/aceptan algo (matrículas).

en.q: The rules we had to follow were quite _____ , everything had to be done according to the letter of the law.
en.r: «stringent» = riguroso, estricto. «lax» = laxo (lo contrario).

en.q: The car had a breakdown and had to be _____ to the nearest garage.
en.r: «tow» = remolcar (un coche averiado).

en.q: The _____ playing of the kids led to a few complaints.
en.r: «boisterous» = bullicioso, alborotador. «loudly» es adverbio (no va delante de un sustantivo).

en.q: The new hi-vis jackets, while functional, were derided as _____ by some.
en.r: «garish» = chillón, llamativo de mal gusto.

en.q: “ _____ I interest you in going to a film later?” she asked
en.r: «Could I interest you in + -ing?» = fórmula cortés para ofrecer algo.

en.q: I really have had a wonderful time, _____ I must be going.
en.r: «nevertheless» = sin embargo, no obstante.

en.q: The client had rudely demanded a bespoke design and, in the end, the tailor _____ complied.
en.r: «begrudgingly» = a regañadientes (cumplió de mala gana).

en.q: As the old saying goes, “too many cooks spoil the _____ ”.
en.r: Refrán «Too many cooks spoil the broth» = muchas manos en un plato hacen mucho garabato.

en.q: Violence _____ in the streets of the capital after reports of election interference begin to circulate.
en.r: Titular de prensa: presente simple para hechos recientes: «Violence erupts…». «erupt» = estallar (violencia).

en.q: The next town is about 20km away _____ , but 27km by road.
en.r: «as the crow flies» = en línea recta (distancia).

en.q: The technician assured them that the new _____ would heat their water twice as fast, using half the electricity.
en.r: «boiler» = caldera (calienta el agua).

en.q: His _____ was mourned by all who knew him.
en.r: «demise» = fallecimiento (formal).

en.q: I'm really sorry about my behaviour, I guess I got a bit carried _____ .
en.r: «get carried away» = dejarse llevar, emocionarse demasiado.

en.q: _____ we forget, it was you that started all of this trouble in the first place!
en.r: «Lest we forget» = para que no olvidemos (fórmula fija).

en.q: Excuse me, waiter? Could I get the _____ please?
en.r: «the check» (inglés americano) / «the bill» (británico) = la cuenta en un restaurante. «cheque» = talón bancario.

en.q: If you are unable to attend in person, a legal _____ must be named to attend in your place.
en.r: «legal representative» = representante legal.

en.q: I bought a dozen tomatoes at the supermarket but when I got home, I realised 3 of them were _____ .
en.r: «spoiled» = estropeado, podrido (comida).

en.q: The car wouldn't start this morning so I _____ make it to work on time.
en.r: «couldn't make it» = no pude llegar (a tiempo).

en.q: If I'd known he was going to get injured so early on, I wouldn't _____ on them winning.
en.r: Condicional tipo 3: «I wouldn't have bet» (bet – bet – bet, irregular).

en.q: He stood up and began to feel dizzy, the wine had really gone to his _____ .
en.r: Expresión «go to one's head» = subirse a la cabeza (el alcohol).

en.q: I loved the twist at the end of the film, I _____ it coming at all.
en.r: Pasado perfecto: algo que no había previsto antes del momento pasado: «I hadn't seen it coming».

en.q: It really annoyed me that I was going _____ spend an extra ten euro because of him.
en.r: «be going to have to + inf» = ir a tener que hacer algo.

en.q: The wiring in the old house had to be redone, the _____ told them it would take him at least 2 weeks.
en.r: «electrician» = electricista.

en.q: The candles had been _____ from early in the evening.
en.r: «light – lit – lit»: «the candles had been lit». «lighted» se usa sobre todo como adjetivo.

en.q: The pastry chef was known for her _____ .
en.r: «cakes» = pasteles (lo propio de una pastelera). «Deserts» = desiertos (desserts lleva doble s).

en.q: The old man was very angry that the government had _____ his pension.
en.r: «cut a pension» = recortar una pensión.

en.q: The woman had assured them that _____ be no rain that day.
en.r: Estilo indirecto: «there will be» → «there would be» tras un verbo en pasado.

en.q: The noise grew and grew until John couldn't _____ it anymore.
en.r: «can't take it anymore» = no aguantarlo más. («put up WITH it» necesitaría la preposición.)

en.q: Being the gentleman that he is, Paul immediately _____ aside to let the ladies pass.
en.r: «stand aside» = hacerse a un lado (stand – stood – stood).

en.q: The girl won a prize for _____ so highly in her exams.
en.r: «score highly» = sacar buena nota.

en.q: The children were _____ with all the sweets they had collected.
en.r: «ecstatic» = eufórico, loco de alegría.

en.q: She was _____ to learn to play the piano really well, just like her favourite singer.
en.r: «be determined to + inf» = estar decidido a.

en.q: My favourite shoes have broken, does anyone know a good _____ who could fix them?
en.r: «cobbler» = zapatero (que arregla zapatos).

en.q: I ate so much chocolate that I thought I was going to _____ .
en.r: «throw up» = vomitar.

en.q: It _____ to suggest that Edu doesn’t like to see us suffer.
en.r: «It is unrealistic to suggest…» = no es realista sugerir… (en tono irónico).

Es una unidad nacional mixta civil/militar que coordina diariamente (en fase pretáctica) la asignación temporal del espacio aéreo en función de las peticiones realizadas por los usuarios (ACC, FMP, y otras agencias acreditadas). La AMC confecciona y distribuye el “Plan de Utilización del Espacio Aéreo” (AUP) a Eurocontrol, a los ACC/FMP y a las AMC adyacentes antes de las 14:00 UTC del día anterior a las operaciones, con un período de validez de 24 horas a partir de las 06:00 UTC del día siguiente. Otorga a una aeronave del · Estado “A” el derecho de desembarcar en el Estado “B” pasajeros, correo y carga tomad os · en el territorio del Estado “A”. · Cuarta Libertad: Llamada Libertad de Transporte al Interior. Define el derecho de una · aeronave del Estado “A” para embarcar pasajeros, correo y carga en el Estado “B”, y que · Comerciales · tengan como destino el Estado “A”. · Quinta Libertad: Llamada Libertad de Transporte Externo Consecutivo. Otorga el derecho · a una aeronave del Estado “A” a embarcar pasajeros, correo y carga en el Estado “B” y · transportarlos hasta otro Estado “C”, con tal y la última parte del vuelo sea una continuación · del vuelo inicial “A”-”B”. · Sexta Libertad: Llamada Libertad de Transporte Externo-Interno. Otorga el derecho a una · aeronave del Estado “A” para que transporte tráfico comercial entre otros dos Estados “B” y · “C”, siempre y cuando haga escala en su propio territorio. · Séptima Libertad: Llamada Libertad de Transporte Externo. Da el derecho a una aeronave · del Estado “A” para que efectúe transporte comercial, enteramente fuera de su territorio, entre · dos Estados “B” y “C”. · Octava Libertad: Llamada Libertad de Cabotaje Consecutivo. Es el derecho que se acuerda Otras · a un Estado para que sus líneas aéreas puedan realizar transporte de cabotaje (interno) en libertades · otro Estado, partiendo (o culminando el servicio) en el país al que pertenece la línea aérea. · Cabotaje: consiste en el transporte aéreo de personas, mercancías o equipajes entre diversos lugares del territorio de un · estado sin abandonarlo. · Novena libertad: Llamada Libertad de Cabotaje autónomo.
